Low Calorie Lemonade
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, January 1, 2010 - 12:30am

Ingredients




3 1/4 cups Cold Water
1/2 cup Lemon Juice
1 1/2 teaspoons Sugar Substitute *

Preparation

1 Combine 3/4 cup cold water, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, and 1 to 2 envelopes or 1/2 teaspoon liquid sugar substitute. Serve over ice and enjoy. Garnish as desired.
 2 * Sugar substitute is either 4 to 8 envelopes or 1 1/2 t or to taste.
